## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (74%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier-1 simulated frozen section cannot exclude in situ carcinoma [F1] and flags superior and lateral margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 74%, InSitu 26% (ECE 5%) | Leans invasive; in situ plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Cannot separate invasive from in situ |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100th-percentile OOD, JPEG-3 [F6] | Passes QC despite extreme OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent models agree on top |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (0.76–0.83) [F5]; contrast BACH_0241 InSitu (0.70) | Nearest neighbors all invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest driver (+2.32, score 2.01); 19/20 AI spot check [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.56, score 1.73); 18/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+0.49); failed 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.67) pushes +0.39 toward invasion (12/20 check) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 risk regions beats random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020), supporting classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes zero (-0.009–0.006, unfaithful), and this case uses unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade in situ carcinoma mimics invasion, like contrast case BACH_0241 (InSitu, 0.70 similarity, differing in duct confinement).
- Simulated frozen-section and level-3 JPEG artifacts (100th-percentile OOD) distort stroma or margins; cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 10, 11**: Verify stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma, especially duct borders in region 10.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 7, 11**: Assess pleomorphism and mitoses directly; ignore the unreliable mitoses score.
3. **Regions 2, 7, 11**: Check superior (108 um) and lateral (215 um) margins; frozen-section stains are blocked.
